articles.title: From Indonesia to Australia to New Zealand, PM Modi charts India's Indo-Pacific arc
articles.summary: In an 'atomized world,' nations prioritize self-interest. India faces critical geopolitical challenges, notably China's strategic efforts to tighten its grip around the nation. Pakistan is also engaged in multi-faceted activities, further complicating regional security. This dynamic necessitates India's constant vigilance and strategic preparedness in navigating complex international relations and potential threats.

articles.title: strict-module added to PyPI
articles.summary: This article discusses a Python software tool, an AST-based linter, recently renamed from 'strict-module'. It's designed to enforce specific coding practices, including Data Transfer Object (DTO) discipline and preventing certain design patterns (facade-ban). This pluggable, framework-agnostic tool aims to improve code quality and structure in Python development by ensuring adherence to set standards, benefiting developers in maintaining robust and clean codebases.

articles.title: China’s submarine missile test signals a new era of nuclear deterrence in the Pacific
articles.summary: China recently conducted a live-fire demonstration of its sea-based nuclear strike capability on July 6, 2026. This significant event, involving a long-range weapon, showcases Beijing's growing military prowess. The action has rattled governments across the Indo-Pacific region and is perceived as a direct message to Washington, raising concerns about regional stability and security dynamics amidst heightened geopolitical tensions.

articles.title: Don't just assemble, innovate: The missing hero in India's smartphone success story
articles.summary: India has emerged as the world's second-largest mobile phone manufacturer, a significant national achievement. This growth is largely attributed to sustained government policy support, particularly the Production Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme. This rise positions India as a crucial player in global supply chain diversification amidst geopolitical tensions, enhancing its economic strength and manufacturing capabilities.

articles.title: Why Is Lockheed Martin Acquiring Ultra Maritime?
articles.summary: Lockheed Martin is acquiring Ultra Maritime for $3.45 billion, a strategic move to significantly enhance its undersea warfare and anti-submarine defense capabilities. This acquisition will bolster Lockheed Martin's technological prowess in naval defense, crucial for addressing modern maritime security challenges and strengthening global defense postures. It highlights the ongoing advancements and consolidations in the defence sector to maintain a competitive edge.
